_rules: Agents may change only `passes` and `evidence`. Set `passes` to true only after running `verify` and seeing it succeed; put the command and result in `evidence`. Adding, removing, or rewording criteria needs human approval.

criteria.description: The Active screen shows the D-09 badge (RUNNING, ENDING, OVERTIME, PAUSED) with the project and task name beneath it, and renders the timer in block digits with a progress bar in the colour band for >50%, <=50%, <=25%, <=10%, paused, overtime, and NO_COLOR, matching reviewed golden files (R-17, R-18, D-09).
Pause/resume excludes paused time from elapsed and survives a relaunch while paused (R-20, R-05).
criteria.evidence: 2026-11-17: go test ./... -count=1 -run 'Pause' -v: 6 PASS (store rows + reopen, TUI freeze/resume, relaunch while paused) (artifacts/phase-2/p2-02-pause.txt)

criteria.description: Extend adds the entered amount; extend from the alert sets remaining to the entered amount per D-10; both are stored as extension rows (R-21, R-32).
Cancel asks for confirmation, and on 'y' stores the task as cancelled and shows the Start screen; 'n' and esc leave it running (R-22).

At zero the alert modal appears, one notification is sent, and the alarm plays until Extend or Complete is chosen; on relaunch in overtime the alert fires at once (R-30, R-31, R-05). Verified with fakes in tests and once by hand on macOS with audible sound and a visible notification.
criteria.verify: go test ./... -count=1 -run 'Alert' -v; then by hand with a 1m task.

criteria.description: Notifier and player pick the right tool per OS, pass the task name as an argument rather than through a shell, and fall back to the terminal bell when no player exists (R-33, R-34).
A second instance on the same data directory exits 1 naming the lock file (R-09), and a terminal smaller than 60x20 shows the too-small message (R-08).
criteria.verify: go test ./... -count=1 -run 'Lock|TooSmall' -v; then by hand: run two instances.

criteria.description: The Start screen has an optional Project input that suggests existing projects as you type; tab accepts the top or highlighted suggestion when it differs from the input and otherwise moves focus; ↑/↓ and esc work the dropdown before focus; the task is stored with the existing project matched case-insensitively (R-12, R-13, R-25, R-26, D-15).
Period ranges, buckets, previous periods, and averages match D-11, including a DST change week, a month end, and a 3-month window crossing a year boundary.
Scorecards show completed count and average per day with previous-period values, signed change, and percentage ('—' when previous is 0); only completed tasks count (R-41, R-42, R-44).

The bar chart renders estimated and actual bars per bucket with legend, y-axis, and the R-43 label formats for each period, and an empty state with no data, matching reviewed golden files (R-43, R-45).

Stats opens from Start and Active, tab cycles periods starting at 7 days, esc returns to the previous screen with the timer still running, and the time-up alert appears over Stats (R-24, R-30, R-40, R-46).
Export writes a new timestamped file in the working directory with all tasks, pauses, and extensions in schema v1, never overwrites, and the path or error is shown (R-47, R-50, D-14).
Every step of the SPEC end-to-end verification passes on macOS and on Ubuntu, run by hand against a scratch --data-dir, with results recorded.
criteria.verify: Follow docs/SPEC.md 'End-to-end verification' on each OS; record per-step results in artifacts/phase-4/.

make check and make release-check pass, the README documents install and usage, and the CHANGELOG has notes for the release.
